name: GitHub Copilot
bestFor: AI pair programming inside the editors and workflows most dev teams already use
description: The most widely adopted AI coding assistant, with inline completions, chat, code review, and agent mode built into VS Code, JetBrains, and GitHub.com itself.

freeTier.limits: 2,000 inline suggestions/month plus limited chat and agent usage

paidTier.notes: Pro is $10/mo ($15 of monthly AI credits); Pro+ $39/mo ($70 of credits); Max $100/mo ($200 of credits) — all with unlimited inline suggestions. Business and Enterprise org plans are priced via sales, with admin-set usage limits.

name: Cursor
bestFor: A full AI-native code editor for teams that want the deepest agentic coding experience
description: A VS Code-based editor built around AI from the ground up, with a multi-file agent (Composer), frontier model access, and enterprise controls — sold since October 2026 inside xAI's X Subscription lineup alongside Grok.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: limited Agent and Chat requests

paidTier.notes: Restructured in October 2026: Plus $8/mo (Grok models only), Premium $30/mo (4x Plus usage; the successor to the old $20 Pro), Super $100/mo (15x), Ultra $200/mo (50x); Teams from $30/user/month; Enterprise custom with pooled usage. Claude, GPT and Gemini models are billed separately at API list price. Existing subscribers can keep their legacy plans.

name: Devin
bestFor: An autonomous AI software engineer that can be assigned whole tickets, not just autocomplete
description: Cognition's agentic AI engineer that plans, writes, tests, and opens PRs for full coding tasks with minimal supervision, run from the cloud or IDE.

freeTier.limits: Free plan with a light quota of agent usage and limited model availability

paidTier.notes: Pro $20/mo; Max $200/mo; Teams from $80/mo base + $40/mo per seat; Enterprise is custom.

name: Amazon Q Developer
bestFor: Teams standardized on AWS who want an AI coding assistant tied into their cloud stack
description: AWS's AI coding assistant with IDE/CLI completions, agentic coding, and large-scale Java version-upgrade automation, billed through AWS.

freeTier.limits: 50 agentic requests/month, IDE and CLI access, 1,000 lines/month for Java upgrades

paidTier.notes: Pro tier is $19/user/month with higher agentic request limits and admin controls.

name: JetBrains AI Assistant
bestFor: Developers already living inside JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.)
description: JetBrains' native AI assistant, including the Junie coding agent, built directly into its IDE family and priced on a credit system.

freeTier.limits: AI Free: 3 AI credits per 30 days

paidTier.notes: AI Pro is $10/mo personal ($20/user/month commercial); AI Ultimate is $30/mo personal ($60/user/month commercial).

name: Claude Code
bestFor: Deep, agentic terminal-based coding on large codebases, from a subscription you may already have
description: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal and IDEs, reading and editing entire codebases, running tests, and committing changes autonomously under supervision.

freeTier.limits: Claude's free chat plan does not include Claude Code

paidTier.notes: Included on Pro ($20/mo, or $17/mo annual), Max (from $100/mo), Team (Standard $25/seat/mo, $20 annual) and Enterprise ($20/seat/mo billed annually, 20-seat minimum, plus usage at API rates).

name: Replit Agent
bestFor: Going from a plain-English prompt to a deployed full-stack app fastest, especially for prototypes
description: An agentic app-building environment that generates, runs, and deploys full-stack applications from natural-language prompts, with a built-in cloud IDE.

freeTier.limits: The free Starter plan was removed in September 2026; Core is now the entry tier

paidTier.notes: Core is $20/mo ($18 billed annually) with $20 of model credits plus Free Mode usage (up to 30 hours of chat, 60 projects); Pro is $100/mo ($90 annually) with $100 of credits and up to 15 collaborators; Enterprise is custom.
